Activists stage a picket protest in Iloilo City on Monday, Feb. 23, as former president Rodrigo Duterte undergoes a confirmation hearing for crimes against humanity in The Hague.

data.raw_text:
Nagsagawa ng “Rally for Justice” ang mga pamilya ng mga biktima ng extrajudicial killings (EJKs), kasama ang ilang militanteng grupo, sa Boy Scout Circle sa Quezon City ngayong Lunes, Pebrero 23, kasabay ng unang araw ng confirmation of charges hearing ni dating Pangulong Rodrigo Duterte sa International Criminal Court (ICC).

BASAHIN: https://t.co/ijBVlRlxw3
data.cleaned_text: Nagsagawa ng “Rally for Justice” ang mga pamilya ng mga biktima ng extrajudicial killings (EJKs), kasama ang ilang militanteng grupo, sa Boy Scout Circle sa Quezon City ngayong Lunes, Pebrero 23, kasabay ng unang araw ng confirmation of charges hearing ni dating Pangulong Rodrigo Duterte sa International Criminal Court (ICC). BASAHIN:
data.english_translation: The families of the extrajudicial kallings (EJKs), together with some militant groups, performed at the Boy Scout Circle in Quezon City this Monday, February 23, with the first day of the confimation of charges hearing by former President Rodrigo Duterte at the International Criminal Court (ICC).
